discipline.rites_and_paths.firearm.name: Gunpowder
ability.rites_and_paths.active_reload.de: When you reload a firearm, a cursor sweeps across a bar. Press the reload key again: in the perfect zone you reload instantly and deal more damage for a few seconds; in the good zone you reload instantly; outside them the gun jams and the reload slows down. Without pressing, the reload is normal.
ability.rites_and_paths.armorer.name: Armorer
ability.rites_and_paths.armorer.desc: Crafting firearm ammunition by hand gives you half as much again (Create's automated lines do not count).
ability.rites_and_paths.bombardment.name: Bombardment
ability.rites_and_paths.bombardment.desc: Mark a distant spot and, shortly after, several shells rain down around it (without breaking blocks or hurting your allies). Uses a small rocket or, if you have none, some gunpowder.
ability.rites_and_paths.dead_eye.name: Dead Eye
ability.rites_and_paths.dead_eye.desc: For a few seconds you mark the enemies your crosshair passes over. When it ends, you shoot each marked enemy in the head, spending ammo from the magazine. Requires a light firearm in hand.
ability.rites_and_paths.deploy_turret.de: Turret key: the firearm in your hand is set down as a turret that shoots your enemies on its own with ammo from your inventory. It breaks in one hit and returns to your inventory. With an empty hand you pick up all your turrets and get their charges back.
ability.rites_and_paths.dig_trench.name: Trench
ability.rites_and_paths.dig_trench.desc: Trench key: you raise a half-circle of barbed wire in front of you. It slows like cobweb and hurts enemies that move inside it; you and your allies are only slowed a little. Only one can exist.
ability.rites_and_paths.fan_the_hammer.d: With the revolver, you empty the cylinder in half a second by fanning the hammer: much more spread and a bit less damage per bullet. Then you reload.
ability.rites_and_paths.last_magazine.de: For a few seconds you spend no ammo and every reload is perfect.
ability.rites_and_paths.rifle_butt.name: Rifle Butt
ability.rites_and_paths.rifle_butt.desc: Your melee hit with a firearm knocks the enemy back and stuns it for an instant (once every few seconds).
ability.rites_and_paths.siege_mode.name: Siege Mode
ability.rites_and_paths.siege_mode.desc: You anchor yourself for a few seconds: you cannot move, but you fire much faster without spending ammo, deal more area damage, take less damage and nothing pushes you.
ability.rites_and_paths.suppressing_fire: For a few seconds you fire faster and your bullets slow enemies.
ability.rites_and_paths.throw_mine.name: Mine
ability.rites_and_paths.throw_mine.desc: Mine key: you throw a mine that turns invisible to your enemies after a second and explodes when one steps on it. You can have three per charge; the oldest one disappears.
Firearms in your hotbar that you are not holding reload on their own, more slowly, with ammo from your inventory.
branch.rites_and_paths.engineer.improvis: Chance for the first bullet after a reload to be special (incendiary, stunning or freezing); with automatic weapons, the first five. An icon next to the crosshair tells you which one comes next.
branch.rites_and_paths.engineer.marksman: Less spread and more damage against distant targets.
branch.rites_and_paths.engineer.moving_r: You move faster while reloading, and a perfect reload gives you a burst of speed for a few seconds.
branch.rites_and_paths.engineer.perfect_: Each perfect reload in a row adds damage, up to six times. It is lost when you jam or go a while without firing.
class.rites_and_paths.engineer.name: Engineer
class.rites_and_paths.engineer.desc: A gunpowder armorer: fires Create: Gunsmithing's firearms better than anyone and makes ammunition for the whole server. Reloading is a minigame: hit the perfect zone to reload instantly and hit harder, or jam the gun. Hits hard, but depends on ammunition that costs effort to make, and is clumsy with magic, bows, shields and heavy weapons.
class.rites_and_paths.engineer.trait: Class trait, Armorer: crafting ammunition by hand gives you half as much again.
message.rites_and_paths.engineer.no_fire: You need a firearm in hand.
message.rites_and_paths.engineer.no_ligh: You need a light firearm in hand.
message.rites_and_paths.engineer.no_powd: You need a small rocket or gunpowder.
message.rites_and_paths.engineer.no_revo: You need the revolver in hand.
param.rites_and_paths.kill_speed: Speed when you kill the challenged
param.rites_and_paths.pull_fraction: Distance pulled by the pull bullet
param.rites_and_paths.rate_per_second: Fire rate per second of firing
perk.rites_and_paths.engineer.holster.ro: When your gun runs dry you instantly switch to the next loaded gun in your hotbar, but the holster reloads more slowly.
perk.rites_and_paths.engineer.holster.th: With an empty gun, left click throws it (butt damage and a stun); it comes back reloaded to your inventory a few seconds later. The holster only reloads thrown guns.
perk.rites_and_paths.engineer.improvised: Adds two special bullets: one makes the target levitate and another teleports it towards you. Bosses are slowed instead.
Adds two special bullets: one poisons and another withers.
perk.rites_and_paths.engineer.marksman.h: Headshots deal more damage, but every other hit deals less.
perk.rites_and_paths.engineer.marksman.s: Hits that are not headshots slow for an instant, but headshots deal less damage.
perk.rites_and_paths.engineer.moving_rel: A perfect reload launches you a few blocks forward (once every few seconds), but reloads that are not perfect take a little longer.
If you reload with an enemy nearby, you move much faster while the reload lasts, but the perfect reload burst is smaller.
perk.rites_and_paths.engineer.perfect_st: Each charge gives more damage, but taking damage removes two charges.
Jamming only removes two charges instead of all of them, but each charge gives less damage.
subclass.rites_and_paths.artificer.name: Artificer
subclass.rites_and_paths.artificer.desc: Turrets and gadgets: turns the gun in hand into a turret, throws invisible mines and raises barbed-wire trenches. All three spend the same charges.
subclass.rites_and_paths.artillerist.des: Heavy fire (gatling, rocket launcher, nailgun, flamethrower and grenades): fires faster the longer the trigger is held, moves faster and resists knockback better with heavy weapons, and bombards areas.
subclass.rites_and_paths.gunslinger.name: Gunslinger
subclass.rites_and_paths.gunslinger.desc: Duelist with light firearms (revolver, flintlock and shotgun): faster fire, instant weapon swaps and a challenged enemy that takes more damage from them and deals less to them.
